x: At 4½ miles Penny was still going as strong as ever and we saw then that Footer was doing his utmost to catch Weatherill. Carter and Abberton were going very well, and Walker and Rice held the 32nd and 33rd position with Robertshaw and W.
The following year at Horton Kirby we were again tenth, but the number of points was reduced to 341 points and our scoring six were: Penny 21, W.
